zh.title: 星宇航空預計2027年底機隊增至48架 明年營收估增逾四成
zh.summary: 星宇航空預計2027年底機隊達48架，明年營收估增逾四成
body: 星宇航空公關長梁文龍表示，機隊規模預計2026年底達42架，2027年底前增加至48架。今年11月至12月預計交付4架飛機，包括1架A350-1000、1架A330-900及2架A321neo；2027年底前預計再交付6架，包括4架A321neo及2架A350-1000。
梁文龍表示，明年受惠交機節奏加快、增班與拓展航點，營收預估年增4成起跳。他也指出，油價是營運最大挑戰和變數。

en.title: Starlux Airlines Expects Fleet to Reach 48 Aircraft by End-2027
en.summary: Starlux Airlines expects 48 aircraft by end-2027; revenue may grow over 40% next year.
body: Starlux Airlines public relations chief Liang Wen-lung said the carrier expects its fleet to reach 42 aircraft by the end of 2026 and 48 by the end of 2027. It expects four aircraft to be delivered in November and December this year: one A350-1000, one A330-900 and two A321neo. A further six aircraft are expected by the end of 2027, comprising four A321neo and two A350-1000.

Liang said revenue is forecast to grow at least 40% next year, with faster deliveries, more flights and route expansion. He also described oil prices as the biggest challenge and variable for operations.

zh.title: 星宇航空增加布拉格、鳳凰城及安大略航班
zh.summary: 星宇航空增加三地班次，並評估達拉斯與芝加哥新航點
body: 星宇航空表示，鳳凰城、布拉格及安大略航點已增班。布拉格航線由每週3班增至4班；鳳凰城及安大略則由每週4班增至5班。星宇航空公關長梁文龍表示，這些航點的載客率與票價表現持穩向上。
吉隆坡航線已由每週5班增至每天1班，並由A321改以A330執飛。星宇航空表示，達拉斯、芝加哥因貨運需求及臺美商務往來，具備評估成為新航點的空間。

en.title: 星宇航空 Adds Flights to Prague, Phoenix and Ontario
en.summary: 星宇航空 increases frequencies to three destinations and is assessing Dallas and Chicago as new routes.
body: 星宇航空 said it has increased service to Phoenix, Prague and Ontario. Prague service rose from three to four flights a week, while Phoenix and Ontario service increased from four to five weekly flights. The airline’s public relations chief, 梁文龍, said passenger load factors and fares at these destinations had remained stable and were trending upward.

Service to Kuala Lumpur has increased from five flights a week to one daily flight, and the route now uses the A330 instead of the A321. 星宇航空 said Dallas and Chicago have potential as new destinations for assessment, citing cargo demand and Taiwan-U.S. business travel.

zh.title: 華信航空提貨運價格脫鉤及敬老優惠票總量管制構想
zh.summary: 華信航空提出貨運價格脫鉤與敬老優惠票總量管制構想，貨運方案仍在檢討中。
body: 華信航空董事長陳大鈞表示，理性上國內線票價應調漲，但政府照顧民眾是另一個考量。報導指出，國內線票價已超過20年未調漲。總經理莊明哲提出貨運價格脫鉤，以及對敬老優惠票實施總量管制的構想。
莊明哲以金門國內線貨運價格新臺幣18元為例，指出相同距離的國際線貨運價格可達100元。華信航空今年第一季已向民航局提出貨運價格方案，目前仍在檢討；敬老優惠票總量管制則仍在內部討論。

en.title: 華信航空 proposes cargo pricing changes and a cap on senior discount tickets
en.summary: 華信航空 proposes cargo-price decoupling and a senior-fare cap; its cargo proposal remains under review.
body: 華信航空 chairman 陳大鈞 said there is a rational case for raising domestic fares, while government support for the public is another consideration. Domestic airfares have not increased for more than 20 years. General manager 莊明哲 proposed decoupling cargo pricing and setting a total limit on discounted senior tickets.

莊明哲 cited a domestic cargo price of NT$18 to 金門, compared with NT$100 for international cargo over the same distance. 華信航空 submitted its cargo-pricing proposal to 民航局 in the first quarter of this year, and it remains under review. The proposed limit on discounted senior tickets remains under internal discussion.

zh.title: 美國航空空中巴士A319乘客涉不當觸碰，警方接應航機
zh.summary: 美國航空航班乘客涉不當觸碰同座乘客，空服員將兩人分開
body: Simple Flying報導，一名乘客在美國航空空中巴士A319（ICAO機型代碼A319）上，涉嫌對同座乘客有不當觸碰。報導摘要稱，該航班於中午飛越威奇托時，空服員在接獲相關通報後將兩名乘客分開；報導標題則稱，航機由警方接應。
相關行為仍以報導所述的指稱呈現，不能視為已確認的犯罪結論。報導提到的處置包括空服員分開兩名乘客，以及警方接應航機。

en.title: Police Meet American Airlines Airbus A319 After Alleged Passenger Groping
en.summary: An American Airlines passenger allegedly groped a seatmate; attendants separated the pair, and police met the aircraft.
body: Simple Flying reported that a passenger aboard an American Airlines Airbus A319 (ICAO type code A319) allegedly groped a seatmate during a midday flight over Wichita. Its summary says flight attendants separated the two passengers after a reported inappropriate touch, while the headline says police met the aircraft.
The contact is described as an allegation, not an established finding. The reported response included the cabin crew separating the passengers and police meeting the aircraft.
